    assert iscube(8) == True, "8 is a cube (2^3)"
    assert iscube(27) == True, "27 is a cube (3^3)"
    assert iscube(64) == True, "64 is a cube (4^3)"
    assert iscube(125) == True, "125 is a cube (5^3)"
    assert iscube(216) == True, "216 is a cube (6^3)"
    assert iscube(1000) == True, "1000 is a cube (10^3)"

    # Test zero
    assert iscube(0) == True, "0 is a cube (0^3)"

    # Test negative perfect cubes (abs is taken, so they should be cubes)
    assert iscube(-1) == True, "-1 is a cube"
    assert iscube(-8) == True, "-8 is a cube"
    assert iscube(-27) == True, "-27 is a cube"
    assert iscube(-64) == True, "-64 is a cube"

    # Test non-cubes
    assert iscube(2) == False, "2 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(3) == False, "3 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(4) == False, "4 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(9) == False, "9 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(10) == False, "10 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(26) == False, "26 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(28) == False, "28 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(-5) == False, "-5 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(-10) == False, "-10 is not a cube"

    # Test larger numbers
    assert iscube(1728) == True, "1728 is a cube (12^3)"
    assert iscube(27000) == True, "27000 is a cube (30^3)"
    assert iscube(1000000) == True, "1000000 is a cube (100^3)"
    assert iscube(1000001) == False, "1000001 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(999999) == False, "999999 is not a cube"

    # Test numbers near cube boundaries (floating point robustness)
    assert iscube(63) == False, "63 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(65) == False, "65 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(124) == False, "124 is not a cube"
    assert iscube(126) == False, "126 is not a cube"

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_iscube()
